title: Implement a Rust expression calculator
description: Implement three calculator functions in Rust: add, subtract, and percent_of. All have unimplemented!() stubs.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the three functions in src/lib.rs:
1. add(a, b) → a + b
2. subtract(a, b) → a - b
3. percent_of(p, total) → (p as f64 / total as f64) * 100.0, or 0.0 if total == 0

Run `cargo test` to verify all 3 tests pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
